mapper.sql: SELECT w.id AS id, w.svc_num AS svcNum, w.cust_name AS custName, w.contact_man AS contactMan, w.contact_phone AS contactPhone, w.developer_name AS developerName, w.scheme_name AS schemeName, w.lvl_name AS lvlName, w.service_name AS serviceName, w.conn_type AS connType, DATE_FORMAT(w.eff_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS effTime, DATE_FORMAT(w.exp_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expTime, w.amount_per_year AS amountPerYear, w.rate_ AS rate, w.user_addr AS userAddr, w.exte_flag AS exteFlag, w.NEW_SCHEME_ID AS newSchemeId, w.NEW_SCHEME_NAME AS newSchemeName, DATE_FORMAT(w.NEW_CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS newCreateTime, DATE_FORMAT(w.NEW_EFF_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS newEffTime, DATE_FORMAT(w.NEW_EXP_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS newExpTime, w.NEW_SCHEME_PERIOD AS newSchemePeriod, w.NEW_SCHEME_FEE AS newSchemeFee, w.RELATION_TYPE_NAME AS relationTypeName, fw.user_status AS userStatus FROM wide_sys_auto_warning w LEFT JOIN ftp_tc_user_cycle_warning fw ON w.ORDER_FLOW_NO = fw.ORDER_FLOW_NO
mapper.select: WHERE w.main_order_flow_no = #{mainOrderFlowNo} ORDER BY w.id ASC
WHERE w.main_order_flow_no = #{mainOrderFlowNo} ORDER BY w.id ASC
